It is also proposed as a writing system for the synthesis of topic outlines through retrieval and multi-perspective question asking.

STORM is specifically described as an LLM-based (Large Language Model-based) writing system, and it is proposed as a paradigm for synthesizing information. The system is designed to create an outline before the actual writing starts, and it is capable of discovering different perspectives and controlling the question-asking process.

In summary, STORM is a proposed writing system that utilizes a combination of natural language processing and machine learning to automate the pre-writing stage, research complicated topics, and write long articles from detailed outlines.
